test_case_name: Open search field (desktop) and perform a search

Type $name into the input field with placeholder 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?'

And then check that the search results are displayed for $name

test_case_name: Login as user on desktop with 'Mantieni L'accesso' checked

intents.intent: Type $email into the input field with placeholder 'E-mail' (desktop)

Click the 'ENTRA' button to submit the login form (desktop)
And then check that the user is logged in and redirected to the dashboard
